subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw core maintain a versioned compatibility contract for passive-capture exports, and should Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 be the only initially supported contract?
rationale: The canonical store can host these records, but producer selection, supported-version lifetime, auto-detection, provenance storage, and collection-completeness semantics create a permanent product commitment.

options.title: Scrollmark v1 first
options.body: Support only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle initially and require separate decisions for legacy or twitter-web-exporter formats.

options.title: Support both producers
options.body: Adopt separate versioned adapters for Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter immediately, accepting a larger fixture and compatibility burden.

options.title: Conversion outside core
options.body: Document a converter into Birdclaw’s canonical backup format and keep producer-specific parsing outside the core CLI.

recommendation.title: Scrollmark v1 first
recommendation.body: Support only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle initially and require separate decisions for legacy or twitter-web-exporter formats.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person as product owner, and this decision changes Birdclaw’s permanent supported ingestion boundary.
